title: Scoped proof: independent P112 batches retain the 64k copy floor
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent calls might appear to share the selected supplier's 64-unit centre charge. This package proves that arbitrary scalar mixing across calls cannot do so in the **common-chart P112 block-root-code model**, even when each term is charged only once on the union of its labels across calls.

For every complex rectangular call-coupling matrix C and every finite exact factorization of `C tensor (X X^T)` with both factors in the respective block-root codes, the minimum copied-pairing-rank charge is **64 rank(C)**. The exact charge is **8m+b**, where m counts active terms and b counts terms with neither side coordinate-aligned. This gives **64k for k independent calls**, the equality cases, and an unrestricted minimum-term corollary: every exact 8k-term factorization automatically satisfies the code hypotheses.

A cheaper independent two-call decoder must therefore have at least 17 active terms, leave the root code, and save at least nine net rank units relative to rank eight at 17 terms. These are necessary conditions, not an outside-code exclusion. Correlated demands can attain 64, but change the requested endpoint. The proof is all-size after explicitly checked finite premises; fixtures are regression evidence.

**Scoped proof and finite certificate; no new supplier or kappa.** The physical interpretation needs the stated separate-total delivery interface. Changed charts, masked identities, temporal source relations, interacting circuits and outside-code overcomplete factors remain open. No selected cold replay, native/compiler implementation, physical budget, Lean proof or human peer review is claimed. Only `research/p112-batch-centre-floor/` is added; selected and frozen inputs are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Task `centre-path-sharing`, priority revision 3; refined to the card's copied-information lower-bound method. Scope key `p112-independent-direct-sum-root-code-union-support-floor`; nonce `afb2871f5b82a11465a83416a203340b`; base/main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. The card's first ceiling and lever checks passed. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1691.

The delta over #845/#1098's finite support lemma and #1180's one-call root-code floor is the all-batch coupling-rank law, exact mixing surcharge, minimum-term corollary and escape budget. #968/#1077 supply frame and complex-coefficient predecessors. This is complementary to #1643/#1664/#1684's fixed-word transport audits, #1633's outside-code excess-rank budgets and #1689's masked-Walsh subfamily. The shared-source two-panel claim in Discussion1516 explicitly changes the independent-input premise and is not excluded.

Fresh complete pagination covered **396 open PRs and 352 Discussion records** at 07:29–07:30 UTC on 2026-10-14; local notes and the ledger were searched. Direct predecessor heads were rechecked. Exact heads, raw source hashes, Git blob IDs, coverage limits and scope comparison are in `SOURCES.json`, `TASK.json` and the README. This is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

Windows, CPython **3.12.2**, standard library and pinned Git history:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-batch-centre-floor
```

The registered replay passes all three commands under `-I -O -B`:

- Primary checker: 511 exact hyperplane/minor witnesses, 64 exceptional support pairings, 451,584 independent-call matrix entries including 250,880 cross-call entries, and 75,264 rectangular-coupling entries; ten semantic controls.
- Separately written geometry auditor: standard doubled roots, set-based binary elimination, modular rank lower bounds plus exact null-vector upper bounds, and subset-expansion integer determinants; all 511 witnesses and 64 pairings match; seven controls. It does not independently check the batch fixtures or certify the all-size proof.
- Disposable renamed-package replay: positive read-only checks and five intended failures from four on-disk corruption groups, including source-blob and receipt corruption. Cross-call crosstalk, correlated-endpoint substitution, outside-code factors and ordinary-versus-Hermitian transpose have explicit controls.

Staged whitespace checks pass. Two separate AI proof reviews found no unresolved mathematical issue; this is not human review. All-size proof and exact finite evidence are separately labeled.

The README retains the full DreamingOfClouds, GamingPuzzled, icekylinx, tensor-code, fixed-word-audit and selected-construction lineage.

Prepared for **alephnan with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in proof, implementation, separate algorithms and adversarial review. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The README gives three bounded handoffs: an exact outside-code 17-term two-call family meeting the nine-unit escape budget; a realized caller with rank-deficient separable coupling and full physical costs; or legal changed label charts with all conversions charged. None is supplied or ruled out here.
